notes:

Technical requirements & targets (from product/eng):

- Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified models (7B-13B class) if quality meets bar; willing to test quantized variants (4-bit, 8-bit) for cost trade-off.
- Routing/fallback: require cheaper fallback model for non-critical queries and automatic fallback to hosted smaller model during Dedicated maintenance windows.

POC & cost-optimization workshop notes (planned):
- Workshop goals: show where batching/caching/quantization move the needle on $/req and p95 latency; produce a recommended config (batch sizes, cache TTL, quant profile) and projected monthly savings.
- Preliminary numbers from Redwood SE run: batching (dynamic batch up to 64) could reduce per-embedding cost by ~30-45% depending on latency SLO; prefix/KV caching for assistant sessions expected to hit 25-35% token saving for repeated flows.
- Quantization: SE suggested testing 4-bit QLoRA-like profile for reranker and 8-bit for assistant generator. Expected small quality delta on reranking (A/B test required).
- Metrics to collect during POC: mean latency, p95 latency, token throughput, cache hit rate, batch utilization, quality regressions (BLEU/precision-at-K for reranker), estimated $/1000 tokens.
